responses.F1: install_atomic.py reserves backup and replacement with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and copies through the open descriptor; controls reject pre-existing adversarial symlink destinations for both paths.
responses.F2: installer requires ORCH, ORCH/bin, ORCH/backups, TMPDIR, extraction root, source checkout, and source ancestry to be physical and owner/mode safe; symlinked receiving parents refuse.
responses.F3: installer takes an atomic receiving lock, rechecks target hash and device/inode under the lock, and uses an O_NOFOLLOW directory fd for the identity-checked rename; changed identity refuses in controls.
responses.F4: post-replacement readback checks target and both helpers for regular non-symlink single-link shape, owner, mode, bytes, hashes, and cmp; any postcommit failure reports INSTALLED_BUT_UNVERIFIED without retry or alternate route.
responses.F5: TMPDIR must be an existing owned physical non-broadly-writable directory outside ORCH and SOURCE_CHECKOUT; the fresh extraction root is revalidated before archive extraction.
responses.F6: source checkout ownership and physical ancestry are enforced before git status/archive use; source commit and clean status remain exact.
responses.F7: installer requires exact E2E_RESULT and INDEPENDENT_REVIEW JSON artifacts before any receiving write; review binds result path/hash, candidate hash, source commit, and receiver identity. Missing or malformed gates refuse and D125b remains HOLD.

context_boundary: The receiving lock is the approved manager boundary. An uncoordinated writer that ignores that boundary is not an allowed route; the script does not claim to serialize such a writer.
